info.text:
Myth: 0% credit utilization gets you the highest score.
myFICO says amounts owed make up about 30% of a FICO Score.
myFICO also says every card reporting $0 can score slightly lower than a small reported balance, because $0 can look like no active use.
Our example: $150 on a $5,000 limit is 3% utilization, and paid in full it costs $0 in interest.
People with 800+ FICO Scores average about 7% utilization (Experian, 2026 data). FICO's US average was 714 in April 2026.
The gap between 0% and a low single-digit percent is tiny, and you never need to carry a balance or pay interest.
Sources: myFICO, FICO, Experian.
News and education, not financial advice.
